wish: someone should make a site where users can write HTML and CSS
spec:
Write HTML and CSS in two panes and see the page render live in a sandboxed preview.
Your work is kept on this device between visits; Download saves it as one standalone .html file.
It does not run JavaScript, load remote images or fonts, or publish anything online.
notes: Preview is a sandboxed iframe with scripts disabled; the page's CSP blocks any remote URLs the user writes, so the preview stays offline.
